blocking_caveats: C-HELPER-v1 includes the missing middle_factor_code bytes but still lacks H_C-specific physical slots, probe/hash/payload semantics, and an unambiguous digest preimage.
ORDER-MANIFEST cardinality/branch binding and the target-key-to-index lookup remain insufficient to exclude a shared full-order or query oracle.
Framing remains inconsistent or incomplete, and the four-byte counter_biguint and eight-byte bounded_count cannot represent several declared cryptographic-scale bounds.
Finite manifest saturation, capped restart probability, primitive FOE equations, T_inc_foe, and exact Q_break_even operands remain undefined.
HNF/saturation/output uniqueness and Construction C middle-factor composition remain incomplete.
External EDGE-CERT availability is an explicit conditional input boundary, not an end-to-end charged attack path; certificate/provider/peak-memory semantics remain incomplete.
Replay event bytes and attempt pairing after early treatment termination are not independently recomputable.
Owner/shuffle singleton and mismatch controls remain under-specified, including S_eff=0/1 handling and null-specific path certificates.
C-pair treatment/null generation and the iid reference under a dependent permutation are not justified or fully serialized.
The synthetic diagnostic keeps its non-SSI boundary but has unresolved seed binding and per-cell versus global-reference semantics.
The snapshot receipt remains pending post-commit self-verification, and the successor's immediate-predecessor input path is metadata-inconsistent.
